about:
Upstate Elevator is based in Burlington, Vermont. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. It began as a Vermont-focused hemp brand emphasizing organic cultivation and transparent testing.

The company manufactures a line of CBD and THC products including gummies, beverages, capsules, tinctures, topicals, and pet chews. All items are described as handcrafted in Vermont using Vermont-grown hemp and are third-party tested. The brand holds USDA Organic certification for select products and formulates with minor cannabinoids such as CBN, CBG, THCV, and CBDA alongside CBD and THC.

Upstate Elevator sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site and also offers a wholesale program for retailers. Its customer base spans the dietary supplement, hemp-derived cannabis, and pet wellness markets. Products are marketed for sleep, calm, relief, focus, and vibe categories.

The company positions itself on "Clean Crafted" principles: USDA Organic certification, third-party lab analysis, and Vermont-sourced hemp. Its stated mission centers on providing clean, tested cannabinoid products grown and made in Vermont.
